notes: FOR-001 deterministic semantic controls. Historical 'benign' and 'triggered' keys
identify the original unchanged generator sides, not ground-truth clean/stego labels.
Every entry maps a registry ID to expected observations; statistics alone do not
set the aggregate forensic verdict and their scores are not steganography probabilities.
Generator specs and fixture bytes are preserved. Every fixture is <= 64 KiB.
The balanced_ascii generator is a text-isolation control, not a claim that balanced
histograms rule out embedding or that all statistical observations stay quiet.
STAT_CHI2 semantics were corrected: ascending_ramp has exactly equal populated
pairs (chi-squared 0, upper-tail p=1), while even_ramp has chi-squared 32768
and rejects pair equality. Counts reverse without changing either sample.
STAT_RS historical ramps are degenerate controls, NOT positive calibration.
With periodic mask0110/default8, ascending_ramp gives quadratic (-2,1,-1)
and negative discriminant; even_ramp has all zero regular/singular differences.
Both are inconclusive. Independently enumerated correlated-cover/random-LSB
replacement rate controls in steganalysis tests calibrate the actual estimator.
DOC-004 counts only DOC-004-family findings; pure PDF structural inventory
uses the separate 'PDF' observation family (mirroring ZIP_TOPOLOGY) and
never sets the verdict. DOC-003 likewise counts only DOC-003-family
findings; extended-part read failures stay DOC-001 topology evidence.

detectors.note: Unchanged historical sides: ascending ramp is perfectly pair-balanced (compatibility observation, not proof of stego); even-only ramp rejects equality. The prior counts pinned the opposite direction.
SPA fires on equalised value pairs with elevated close-pair ratio (adjacent ramp bytes differ by 1).
Both unchanged ramps are analytically degenerate/inconclusive RS controls, not clean negatives or a claim that the estimator cannot detect random-LSB replacement.
Benign text has no known magic prefix (unknown family); the PNG header identifies the png family.
One inline STG3 packet magic in otherwise inert bytes.
A 12-character ZWSP/ZWNJ run crosses the 8-character bit-encoding threshold.
A CDP variation selector (U+E0100) outside emoji context is always flagged.
A single U+202E override is the trojan-source class marker.
Six lines with 4 trailing spaces each form the classic per-line whitespace channel.
Cyrillic a (U+0430) inside an ASCII word is a strong confusable.
Every ZIP-family input yields exactly one inventory observation; non-ZIP input yields none.
The triggered docx claims ~2 GiB uncompressed for its main part, exceeding the 4 MiB per-entry inflate budget; the rejection is DOC-001 evidence and never sets the steganographic verdict.
The triggered docx carries a zero-width-laced word/document.xml; the concealment finding sets the scan verdict.
The triggered pptx carries a zero-width-laced ppt/slides/slide1.xml; the concealment finding sets the scan verdict. Clean pptx/xlsx/docx extended parts yield no DOC-003 findings.
The triggered pdf declares an /EmbeddedFile object; the structural inventory stays under the 'PDF' observation family and the concealment finding sets the scan verdict.
